summary: FIR quashing under Aircraft Act, 1934 vs IPC; special statute not exclusive; simultaneous prosecution under IPC allowed; Section 12B Aircraft Act not a bar to FIR registration; investigation permissible prior to complaint by competent authority; High Court erred in quashing proceedings on grounds of mala fide and abuse of process; ATC room entry as security breach; violation of Airport (Security) Rules, 2011; sunset take-off without night-facility; cognizance under IPC sustainable alongside special law.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.336, s.447, s.448
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.154(1), s.173, s.190(1)(d)
State (NCT) of Delhi vs. Sanjay, (2014) 9 SCC 772
Jayant & Ors. vs. State of Madhya Pradesh, (2021) 2 SCC 670
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment quashing FIR set aside; criminal proceedings reinstated.
